name: Creekside Cabins & RV Park
evidence: Esri z19 at 38.1703,-82.6758 and 38.1693,-82.6765: east rig row ~25-30 m from the creek behind a continuous tree band; other rows on open lawn by a drainage ditch, creek 30 m+ off behind trees. Operator site names no creek sites; 'creekside fishing/kayak landing' is prose only.

name: Kentucky Lakes / Prizer Point KOA
evidence: KOA site maps: Premium Lakeside Pull-Thrus 11-22 on the lake side of Ontario Rd, Deluxe Patio 508-515 at the marina cove. Esri z19 + 3DEP: north-shore lane at 110.3-111.4 m, 1-2 m above 109.4 m summer pool at ~5-17 m over a gentle open bank; RV at 36.90932,-87.98800 1.3 m up, ~15 m from the pool line. Superior Loop 2-9: loop road between = view.

name: Paintsville Lake State Park
evidence: Esri z18/z19 at 37.8430,-82.8785 and 37.8440,-82.8786: southernmost west-side pads ~47-60 m from shore through a wooded strip; south pads face across the day-use lawn (shelter, playground) to shore ~70 m. 3DEP pads ~220.1 m. RA 'Waterfront Site: Y' on 001-004/018-020 not borne out at the waterline.

name: The Falls Campground
evidence: Operator map draws A28-A40 along Blaine Creek's south bank below the falls. Esri z19 (s1609_e) + 3DEP: trailer at 38.17633,-82.67455 (169.2 m) on open grass ~21 m from the creek edge (~166.6 m), 2.5 m rise at ~12%, nothing between; operator gallery photo shows RVs on lawn by the rapids. Beach-top row ~70 m across own swim beach = view.

name: Conley Bottom Resort
evidence: Official 2024 resort map (CBR-2024-Map-Front.png): nightly Perch 1N-8N on the east edge, 1N at the peninsula tip. Esri z19 + 3DEP: tip pad with trailers at 36.95247,-84.82572 (222.7 m) ~14 m over open bank to the 220.4 m summer pool (~16%); rest of Perch/Sunfish 20-26 m back through trees, 3-5 m up = view. First-come sites.

name: Lake Jericho Recreation Area
evidence: ResNexus site map draws 19/20/23/26/27 outside the west loop road, but Esri z19 (s1623_w) shows only a grass spur ending ~32 m from shore (242.3 m vs lake 238.9 m) with no legible pad, and a pull-off ~47 m back 8 m up; outer road ~55 m from shore over mowed lawn. No unit named waterfront.

name: Laurel Branch Campground
evidence: rec.gov per-site 'Proximity to Water: Lakefront' on 31 RV sites (B21-B24, C31-C53, D54-D62; max length 30-82 ft). Esri z19 at 37.6062,-86.4620 + 3DEP: C46-C51 pads 152.2-153.7 m, 1.3-2.8 m above 150.9 m pool, ~7-15 m from the edge over an open gravel/grass point.

name: Cumberland Point Campground
evidence: Kept on --AWH firsthand note ('about 14 of 30 sites directly on the lakeshore'). My reading: Esri z19 + 3DEP, site 10 (36.965265,-84.840304) at 232.7 m, ~12 m above the 220.4 m pool, down a ~30 m wooded slope = view; see flags.
